title: What 8 classic brawlers agree on
intro: Final Fight (1989), Captain Commando (1991), Warriors of Fate (1992), Streets of Rage 2 (1992), The Punisher (1993), Cadillacs and Dinosaurs (1993), Alien vs. Predator (1994), D&D Shadow over Mystara (1996), measured from their code and in captures.
universal: A chain advances ONLY on hit; a whiff (or being hit) restarts it. → principle 1 holds everywhere: the first hit gates everything.
The special (desperation) costs life ONLY on contact (6-12), is invincible, and in the later games never kills.
Throws are invincible for their whole animation; a thrown body hits other enemies.
Enemies: no attack token in any Capcom game (3-5 attackers at once happen); aggression rises with a hidden difficulty rank (FF, CC, WoF, Punisher, Dino).
evolution: same length, more damage (SOR2 Max 1.5x, Dino Mess +10-20 %)
4 for all (CC, SOR2, Punisher, Dino); WoF 3 for all
presses latched during hit-stop (WoF, Dino); SOR2 buffers the special 20 f; FF/CC/Punisher/Mystara none
per move, heavier = longer (AvP 3-13, WoF 3-11, Punisher 7/9/10 + 6-f shake, Dino 9 / 12-13); SOR2 4 + damage/4 cap 8; CC 7 / Mystara 8 flat
throw on link 2 (WoF) / link 4 (Punisher, Dino), stepping turns (CC), command cancels (AvP, Mystara)
none in the CPS1 line; AvP stun meter → launch, juggle cap 3; Mystara cancel matrix ending in a dead-end move
shared walk + jump (CC, WoF walk, Mystara), per character again in SOR2 / Dino
random spread (WoF, Dino), rank-scaled enemy damage
brakes: AvP caps juggles at 3 and speeds up the get-up; Mystara lets you cancel anything but every route ends in ↓↑A, the chain restarts only from standing, air victims hang then drift out of reach, downed enemies can't be hit. Everyone else simply makes downed enemies untouchable.
proposals: Advance on hit only; link window ~30-40 f after recovery; presses during hit-stop latched (plus 4-6 f buffer) — the later-Capcom way, and what keeps a slow heavy smooth.
Chain length the same for every archetype (4); heavy = ~1.5x damage per hit and longer hit-stop; fast may get +1 link (AvP / Mystara pattern).
Hit-stop per move, heavier hit = longer: ~6 (jab) to ~12 (finisher), the same scale for every fighter (consistency).
Enemy hit-stun ~28-32; player hit-stun short (~12-20) plus a brief untouchable window, so crowds can't juggle you.
Juggles with a brake: a launch (finisher or a stun meter) and a hard cap (AvP's 3), or a route that ends in a dead-end move (Mystara); downed enemies untouchable.
Special: invincible, costs life only on contact, never kills.
Throws invincible; the thrown body's hit refills your chain credit (FF's accident, kept on purpose).
Enemies: random wait in a readable "ready" pose, wind-up proportional to damage; a small attack token (2) — a deliberate departure, none of the 8 games has one.
